decisions.decision: Workspace convention IS +X = robot's RIGHT, +Y = FORWARD (away from base), +Z = UP
decisions.rationale: Empirically verified 2026-05-03 via verify_baselink_motion.py — drove robot in commanded base_link direction, operator confirmed which side the robot moved. Original verbal '+X = LEFT' was incorrect.

decisions.decision: Wrapper sends task_frame in `base` frame (NOT base_link), with explicit X/Y sign flip on the wrench
decisions.rationale: force_mode_controller silently auto-transforms task_frame from header.frame_id to `<tf_prefix>base`. base ↔ base_link is R_z(180°). Sending frame_id=`base_link` + raw wrench produces silent X/Y inversion. For Z-only insertion (today) this was a no-op; for any future X/Y commanded force it would have been a latent bug. Now correct end-to-end.

decisions.decision: HOME_JOINTS = [+90°, -90°, +90°, -90°, -90°, 0°] is the calibration-tidy joint-space home
decisions.rationale: Operator's rectangular workspace places the robot base at the long-side center; EE only sits inside the workspace when shoulder_pan = +90°. Rest of joints chosen to match calibration starting orientation so calibration entry needs no arm reconfiguration.

decisions.decision: All 8 CALIBRATION_POSES_RAD rotated +π/2 in shoulder_pan to match HOME_JOINTS + workspace
decisions.rationale: Kubus 2007 LSQ is invariant under rotations about base Z (the rotation is absorbed in g-in-FT vector distribution; recovered mass + CoG identical). Keeps EE inside workspace throughout calibration.

decisions.decision: F/T payload calibration accepted with mild residual warnings (max 0.86 N, 0.062 Nm)
decisions.rationale: Above the 0.5 N / 0.05 Nm 'optimal' thresholds but rank 10/10 and condition number 16.3 (well under 100). Most likely cause is sensor not warmed up (typically wants 10-30 min idle in a pose before calibration). Operator accepted these values; smoke test passed cleanly post-paste. Could re-run after warmup for a tighter fit if Phase 3 data shows orientation-dependent bias.

decisions.decision: Local mode + bringup restart requires manual STOP+PLAY on pendant
decisions.rationale: When close_robot.sh runs and a new bringup launches, the External Control URCap loses its link. Pendant still shows Play active but the link is stale, manifesting as 'Velocity or acceleration limits exceeded' on any move. Dashboard /play /stop are blocked in Local mode (verified empirically). launch_robot.sh real now documents this in its NEXT STEPS block.

context_notes: Phase 1 [R]-half is DONE this session. Calibration validated: gripper mass 2.11 kg + CoG ≈ origin-aligned + 32 mm into the tool. Smoke test passes cleanly after operator pasted set_target_payload(2.1109, [-0.0032, 0.0031, -0.0318]) into bringup launch. The big architectural finding of the session: the wrapper's force-mode wrench was being sent in the wrong frame (frame_id=base_link silently auto-transformed to base, flipping X/Y). Now corrected — and empirically verified. The dx/dy/dz workspace convention also corrected (+X = robot's RIGHT, not LEFT as originally stated). HOME_JOINTS introduced as a workspace-aware calibration-tidy joint-space home (operator's rectangle requires shoulder_pan=+90°; the regular Cartesian HOME_POSE IK landed at +79°, causing the original calibration to protective-stop on the wrist swings between poses). Calibration poses also rotated +90° in shoulder_pan to match. WRAP-VERIFY is the only remaining at-robot task before Phase 3 data collection — needs operator to physically set up u_brown on the FMB1 base + grasp it. Risk for next session: the wrapper has subprocess integrations (HOVER via translate_object, smoke test, move_home, move_to_safe_height, move_home exit) — any of these could surface real-hardware bugs the synthetic CSV test can't catch.
